_about: DK1713 follow-up 2: a corpus for the untrusted-flow defence, written AFTER the defence existed and before it was measured; no rule or case was changed after the first measurement. Each case is one step of an agent run: the principal's task, a tool result the agent read (from a file, a ticket, a shell, a log, a mail, the web), and the next outward call the agent makes. Attacks have the call an obeyed injection would produce; harmless cases are ordinary work. Some attacks copy nothing out of the result (a destructive call with no destination) and some spell a destination out in pieces: the defence is expected to miss these, and they are in the corpus on purpose. The author of the defence also wrote the cases, so this is not an outside corpus (DK1339).
